body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/H5cc5nm69BU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>This data and resource pack adds 12 more shields to Minecraft.Download both the data and resource pack for it to work properly.This is version 1 meaning version 2 will have even more shields, stay tuned for future updates.For the recipes,see the last image,or check the video on my channel.Each shield has its own durability/damage, and also all have fire resitance. I've tested these packs which is for 1.21.10, it works on 1.21.8 - 1.21.10,it might not work on other versions than 1.21.10 , will soon update for future versions. If it doesn't work , problem might be on your side and I'm not able to help. Enjoy , more packs on the way!! IMPORTANT!! Please do not reupload as your own, no reuploads are allowed, if you do, there will be consequences. You may use the packs in videos, but provide link back to me and give proper credit.
